question: Amira designed 151 enamel badges for the club fair. The printer produced 3 copies of every one of them, so her stock tripled overnight. Her teammate Josef, whose own design had sold far fewer, contributed 27 badges from his box. The stall was open for 4 days on the seafront. Every badge in the crate is supplied with 6 fastening pins, and the organisers handed Amira 49 loose pins from the stores. How many fastening pins did Amira have?

The phone shop had 14 display handsets on its counter when it opened in the morning, and the tariffs there are quoted in minutes rather than in hours. A queue of early customers bought 13 of the handsets before the manager arrived. The shop discovered that 4 chargers were boxed with every handset still on the counter. During the afternoon a wholesaler delivered 54 more chargers. In the evening a repair shop returned 8 chargers it had borrowed. How many chargers did the shop have?

Elias keeps 19 sheets of old stamps in a folder, and each sheet is divided into 6 blocks. Every block on those sheets holds 8 separate stamps, and half of them come from countries that no longer exist. His aunt Marisol, whose own album is much thinner than his folder, gave him 11 loose stamps for his birthday. At a collectors fair Elias traded away 809 stamps for a single rare cover. How many stamps did Elias have left?

The theatre wardrobe held 143 costumes at the end of the run. A touring company borrowed 137 of them for a production in another city. A dozen dressers work backstage on a busy night. Every costume still hanging in the wardrobe needs 6 replacement buttons before the revival. The head of wardrobe found 53 matching buttons in her sewing box and added them. She then used 40 of the buttons on a long coat for the lead. How many buttons were left?

The choir library held 217 sheets of music before the summer concert. The conductor sent 109 of the sheets to the county archive for safekeeping. Every sheet that stayed was copied 6 times for the singers. Bea and her fellow librarian Nils then divided all the copies equally among the 3 voice sections, and Bea took charge of the set for the sopranos, which Nils agreed was the largest job of the three. Each copy in that set runs to 9 printed pages. How many printed pages were in the sopranos' set?

The council planted 204 flower beds in the park last autumn, and 6 tulips went into every bed. Half of the beds lie along the edge of the lake. A hard frost in February killed 221 of the tulips. The parks team replanted 45 tulips in the gaps as soon as the ground softened. The park itself covers 15 hectares. Every tulip that flowered opened with 8 petals, and the show display in the glasshouse contributed 79 further petals to the count. How many petals were counted in the park?

The youth club owned 86 board games at the start of the year, and it times its sessions in minutes rather than in hours. It lent 40 of the games permanently to a hospital play room. Half of the games in the cupboard are for two players only. Parents donated 15 games in the spring, and the club bought 63 more at a closing-down sale. The leader then shared all the games equally among the 4 branch clubs and drove one branch's share across town. How many games did that branch receive?

A second-hand bookshop had 191 crates of stock in its cellar and bought 26 more from a house clearance. Every crate holds 8 books once they are unpacked. Each book was listed on 4 separate online marketplaces by the shop assistant. The owner added 13 listings that he typed in by hand for rare items. Over the year 3451 of the listings expired without a sale and were taken down. How many listings were still live?

A soap workshop made 46 batches of lavender soap last month, and every batch sets into 5 solid blocks. A trial run added 21 further blocks, and a partner workshop sent over 71 blocks of its own. The workshop weighs its oils in grams rather than in kilograms. Every block on the cutting bench is sliced into 4 bars. The store room also held 29 finished bars from the previous month. How many bars did the workshop have?

A tree nursery filled 209 trays for the reforestation scheme, and each tray was sown with 6 seedlings. Half of the seedlings were driven up to the northern site, and half stayed in the propagation shed. The site has 7 greenhouses along its southern fence. Every seedling left in the shed grew 5 leaves by midsummer. An infestation of caterpillars then stripped 1902 leaves from the trays. How many leaves were left in the shed?

The warehouse held 214 sacks of rice when it opened in the morning. Half of them were sent straight down to the docks, and half stayed on the floor. A lorry, which holds 40 sacks when full, delivered 55 more during the morning. At midday the stock on the floor was divided equally between 2 town stores, and the manager travelled with the load for the High Street store. That store sold 25 sacks over the afternoon and took back 22 sacks from a cancelled order. In the evening every sack in the High Street store was split into 3 retail bags. How many retail bags did the High Street store have?

The old cinema has 30 rows in its main screen, and every row holds 7 seats. Half of the screenings in the season are matinees. Ola manages the box office and Yusuf the projection room, and between them they booked every seat in the house for each of the 8 screenings in the festival. The theatre then sold 77 standing tickets at the back of the hall. Yusuf reserved 28 further places for the staff and their guests. How many places were taken in total?

A collector had 122 vinyl records stacked along his living room wall. He sold 110 of them to a dealer who came with a van. The record shop in town has 3 listening booths. Every record he kept came with 2 printed inserts inside the sleeve. He mislaid 16 of the inserts during a house move. Sorting through a box, he found 5 more inserts he had forgotten about, and he later gave 12 inserts to a friend who was framing them. How many inserts did the collector still have?

Marco was given 108 chocolate bars for the school trip. He shared them equally with his sister Lena, who had brought none of her own, so each of them took half. Every bar in Marco's share is scored into 7 small squares. The children on the coach ate 223 of Marco's squares before the ferry. At the hotel he was handed 76 more squares from an opened box. How many squares did Marco have?

The cattery had 125 tins of cat food in its store, and it gives all feeding amounts in grams rather than in kilograms. A long busy fortnight used up 120 of the tins. The cattery has 18 pens along the south wall. A wholesaler then delivered 44 tins, and the owner bought 76 more at a cash and carry. Over the following month 91 tins were opened. Each tin still in the store provides 2 meals. How many meals are in the store?

The car showroom opened the morning with 150 test-drive slots free in its diary. Bookings taken over the phone before ten o'clock filled 108 of them. The showroom stocks 24 different models. A run of cancellations freed up 11 slots again just before lunch. Walk-in customers took 40 slots during the afternoon. In the evening an online promotion filled another 11 slots. How many slots were still free?

The wire depot counted 203 rolls in the yard when it opened in the morning, and a supplier dropped off 10 more before eight. A dozen workers were on the early shift. Every roll on the rack is drawn out into 9 straight lengths. During the afternoon each length was chopped into 4 shorter pieces on the bench saw. In the evening every piece was bent into 4 hooks for the garden centre order. How many hooks did the depot make?

The courier depot loaded 120 parcels into its bay at the start of the day, and it quotes delivery windows in minutes rather than in hours. The parcels were split equally among the 4 rounds, and the supervisor followed the van doing the morning round. That driver collected 73 further parcels from a business park. She then delivered 29 parcels along the ring road. A second pick-up put 66 more parcels into her van. Before returning she delivered 116 parcels around the housing estate. How many parcels were still in her van?

Ida had 199 seed packets stored in her potting shed. Her neighbour Omar, whose shelf held far fewer than hers, gave her 33 packets he would never use, and the garden shop threw in 12 more with an order. Every packet held enough for 2 sowings, so Ida relabelled her stock as that many single sowings. She used 409 of the sowings across her beds in the spring, and 1 more was ruined when a mouse got into the shed. Late in the year she was given 22 further sowings by the allotment society. How many sowings did Ida have?

Amina opened her workroom in the morning with 219 rolls of curtain fabric, and she measures every length in centimetres rather than in metres. She sold 39 rolls to a hotel buyer before lunch. Each roll still on the shelf was cut into 8 panels. During the afternoon 1197 panels were sewn up into finished curtains and sent out. In the evening every panel that remained was decorated with 9 glass beads, and her colleague Tobias, who kept a smaller bead box than hers, contributed 50 loose beads. How many beads were in the workroom?

Ryo had 44 unbuilt model kits stacked in his cupboard, and the shop sells its paint in millilitres rather than in litres. He gave 27 of the kits to his cousin Nina, who had none at all. Every kit still in the cupboard contains 5 plastic sprues, and each sprue holds 6 separate parts. The club meets for 2 hours on a Thursday. Ryo found 13 loose parts at the bottom of the cupboard, and Nina returned 51 parts she did not need. How many parts did Ryo have?

The garage had 121 tyres stacked behind the workshop. An inspection condemned 4 of them and they went for scrap. Customers traded in 15 part-worn tyres over the month, and a wholesaler delivered 77 new ones. The fitters put 114 tyres onto customer cars during the same period. Every tyre still in the stack has to be stored with 4 wheel nuts taped to it. How many wheel nuts does the stack need?

Farah had 208 blank discs ready for the archive project. Her colleague Owen, whose own supply was smaller, handed her 77 discs from the media room. Testing showed 38 of the discs to be faulty and they were binned. Every good disc holds 4 recorded albums from the collection. A licensing review forced the archive to delete 298 of those albums. Owen then supplied 58 further albums from his own tapes. How many albums does the archive hold?

The city planted 207 street trees along the new avenue last winter and added 43 more in the spring. Half of them are limes. The avenue itself runs for 3 kilometres. By May every tree carried 9 flowering branches. Each branch opened with 8 blossoms in the warm week that followed. A night of storms then brought down 9117 blossoms onto the pavements. How many blossoms were still on the trees?

Selin drew 19 comic strips for the school magazine. She looked them over and threw away 7 that she had never finished. She then shared the finished strips equally with her co-editor Kaan, who had drawn none himself, so each of them took half. The printer sent Selin 78 further strips submitted by other pupils, and she added them to her own set. Every strip in her set is laid out across 2 magazine pages. How many magazine pages does Selin's set fill?
